_status: DRAFT_01 (Sonnet作成案。Fableが確定する。確定前のJudge校正はdraftで先行)

draw a line.ok_ja: 線引き・境界(許容と不許容の区別)をはっきり示す。例: 区別をはっきりさせる/一線を画す/線引きをする
draw a line.ng_ja: 字義の『線を引く』『境界線を引く』(描く動作)
draw a line.ok_en: to set or show a clear boundary or limit between what is acceptable and what is not (to make a clear distinction)
draw a line.alt: 『一線を引く』は日本語でも慣用で通じるが『許容の限界を定める』含意が強く本文の『区別を示す』よりやや強い。許容範囲内かはFable判断

pull someone under.ok_ja: (人を)水中へ引きずり込む/沈める
pull someone under.ng_ja: 比喩の『破滅させる』『苦境に引きずり込む』
pull someone under.ok_en: to pull a person down below the surface of water
pull someone under.alt: 比喩解釈は本文(川で流される場面)から不可

sentence someone to death.usage: literal-legal(慣用的ではなく法的な字義)
sentence someone to death.ok_ja: (人に)死刑を宣告する/死刑判決を下す
sentence someone to death.ng_ja: 『死ぬよう文を作る』等の語ごとの直訳
sentence someone to death.ok_en: to officially order that a person be put to death as punishment

shine a light on.ok_ja: (問題・側面)に光を当てる/注目を集めて明らかにする/あぶり出す
shine a light on.ng_ja: 字義の『光を照らす』のみで比喩が伝わらない訳は不可
shine a light on.ok_en: to draw attention to something so people can see or understand it better
shine a light on.alt: 日本語『光を当てる』は比喩が同じ意味で通じる(逐語に数えない)

reach for someone's wallet.usage: figurative-literal境界(財布に手を伸ばす=支払う準備をする)
reach for someone's wallet.ok_ja: (人が)お金を払おうとして財布に手を伸ばす/財布を出す
reach for someone's wallet.ok_en: to take out money to pay for something (reach to get one's money)
reach for someone's wallet.alt: 本文では『罰金が怖くて財布を出す気になる』程度。字義の動作+支払い含意で可

fire the starting gun.ok_ja: (競争・動きの)開始の合図を出す/幕を開ける/号砲を鳴らす
fire the starting gun.ok_en: to signal or cause the beginning of something (such as a race or process)

Carry the Load.usage: figurative(見出し。大きいバッグが荷物を運ぶ=負担を担う役割)
Carry the Load.ok_ja: (負担・役割)を担う/重い役目を受け持つ。本文では大きなバッグが荷物を運ぶ役割(字義と比喩が重なる)
Carry the Load.ng_ja: なし(字義の『荷物を運ぶ』も本文では文脈上許容範囲に入りうる)
Carry the Load.ok_en: to take on the main work or responsibility (to bear the heavy part)
Carry the Load.alt: 正解が曖昧: 字義(運ぶ)と比喩(負担を担う)が重なる。Fable確定要

brace yourself for.ok_ja: (困難・衝撃)に備えて身構える/覚悟する
brace yourself for.ok_en: to prepare yourself for something difficult or unpleasant that is about to happen
brace yourself for.alt: 本文『時期尚早』の否定文脈。用法は同じ

apply one's findings.ok_ja: (自分の/研究の)結果・知見を(実際の場面に)当てはめる/応用する
apply one's findings.ok_en: to use the results of research in another real situation

refueling support.ok_ja: 給油支援/空中給油などの燃料補給の支援
refueling support.ng_ja: 『燃料を補う力』等の抽象化しすぎ
refueling support.ok_en: help that supplies fuel to vehicles or aircraft
refueling support.alt: 『空中』は本文の条件。一般義は『燃料補給の支援』

execution bell.ok_ja: 死刑執行を告げる鐘/処刑の鐘
execution bell.ok_en: a bell rung to announce or mark an execution
execution bell.alt: executionは表現の定義語なのでcore混入に数えない

leap into action.ok_ja: すぐに行動に移る/飛びついて動き出す
leap into action.ng_ja: 『行動に飛び込む』の直訳のみ
leap into action.ok_en: to start doing something quickly and eagerly
leap into action.alt: 本文は『飛びつく』のニュアンス(性急)

take the wheel.usage: figurative(本文では運転席=主導・責任を引き受ける、ただし直前に『運転しない』の比喩的文脈で字義と比喩が重なる)
take the wheel.ok_ja: ハンドルを握る/運転する(責任を引き受ける・主導する)
take the wheel.ok_en: to take control or responsibility (to drive/steer)
take the wheel.alt: 本文は『運転する』比喩の例えの中の字義。Fable確定要

bring in.ok_ja: (物・作品を)持ち込む/取り入れる
bring in.ok_en: to take or introduce something into a place or system
bring in.alt: 本文は二次創作サービスに『好きなものを持ち込む』

hold on.usage: phrasal(慣用: ちょっと待て)
hold on.ok_ja: ちょっと待つ/待った、早まるな
hold on.ok_en: to wait and not act or decide yet (stop for a moment)

letter of introduction.ok_en: a letter that introduces a person to someone else

on the throne.usage: figurative(権威の座にある=支配的な位置)
on the throne.ok_ja: 王座にある/(流行の)頂点に君臨する/主役の座にある
on the throne.ng_ja: 字義の『玉座に座っている』のみ
on the throne.ok_en: in the position of greatest power or importance
on the throne.alt: 日本語『王座に就く』は比喩が通じる。本文は『ワンサイズだけが君臨する時代』

off the hook.ok_ja: 責任・非難を免れて/お咎めなしで
off the hook.ok_en: no longer in trouble or responsible for something

turn on its head.ok_ja: (考え・状況)をひっくり返す/正反対にする
turn on its head.ok_en: to completely reverse or change something so it becomes the opposite
turn on its head.alt: 本文は受動形(turned on its head)

jump to conclusions.ok_ja: 早合点する/結論を急ぐ
jump to conclusions.ok_en: to decide something too quickly without enough evidence
